search.rule: Advance the four lowest seed-0 three-fold means plus the previous v12 incumbent. Select by the nine equally weighted cells across seeds 0, 1 and 2 and three folds, with lexical tie breaking. Screen1_0 has no role in this choice.
search.confirmation: Evaluate locked settings on fresh paired seeds 84-99. Include prior strongest v11 and EMPF controls and equal-setting v11/equal-rate EMPF controls. Record point ordering and paired uncertainty. No candidate selection on outer scores.
